milestones.claim: Review scope and source inventory recorded
milestones.doneMeans: Findings report contains a trusted source map: canonical root confirmation, command-surface inventory, doc inventory, test inventory, stale-doc register.

milestones.claim: Read-only status boundary verified or gaps filed
milestones.doneMeans: Findings report M1 section records boundary finding or pass for milestone_status argument boundary, missing-ledger non-write, no launches, no evidence writes, no DONE claims.

milestones.claim: Ledger write contract verified or gaps filed
milestones.doneMeans: Findings report M2 section records write-surface finding or pass covering phase policy, ownership, hash and candidate/confirmed behavior, overwrite safety.

milestones.claim: Missing-ledger policy verified across story classes
milestones.doneMeans: Findings report M3 section records the missing-state matrix for ordinary, triggered, candidate, and confirmed cases with DEV/REVIEW/DONE behavior.

milestones.claim: Schema adequacy for honest progress reporting decided
milestones.doneMeans: Findings report M4 section records schema adequacy finding covering required fields, binding refs, status values, parent/child support, prose-claim resistance.
Findings report M5 section maps existing tests to M5.a-M5.e and lists missing negative controls as findings.

milestones.claim: Agent capability impact bounded without overclaim
milestones.doneMeans: Findings report M6 section confirms capability claims (progress, admission safety, handoff) stop short of lifecycle DONE or Authority claims.

milestones.claim: Review outcome and next story decision recorded
milestones.doneMeans: Findings report closure section summarizes pass/finding outcomes, records the implementation decision, and plan doc statuses plus NAV are updated.
